headline: The Plot Thickens! Rumors About shootout Continue to Grow!
body:
Lt. Mara "Hammerhead" Reyes continues to wow us! Their latest project may be their biggest achievement yet!

While fans laud this new braindance as [Adjective], [Adjective], and even [Adjective], critics have had harsher words. Wakako Okada’s notoriously straightforward column even took a threatening turn. “If the Upper Marina cancel the premiere, maybe someone will do us a favor and blow up the freakin’ place before Lt. Mara "Hammerhead" Reyes can inflict any more of this crap on us,” Wakako Okada wrote.

The fan’s have just one question: Just what will Marcus "Ledger" Okonkwo do next?!
